claim: You can use organization policies when all features are enabled in the organization; with only the consolidated billing features you can't use policies to restrict what users and roles in different accounts can do, and SCPs aren't available.

evidence.quote: You can use policies when all features are enabled in your organization.
For example, you can't enable other AWS services to integrate with your organization to work across all of its accounts, or use policies to restrict what users and roles in different accounts can do.
SCPs aren't available if your organization has enabled only the consolidated billing features.
